Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Shai Hope and Kyle Mayers are the openers for West Indies. Mohammed Siraj to start with the ball.
...The Chase...

Right then! West Indies have a tough task ahead and they need someone to anchor the innings. Their batters are not in good form but will hope to get into the groove here and put in a solid performance. Stay tuned for the chase as we will be back in a bit.

Shubman Gill is up for a chat. He says that it was a good wicket to bat on and he enjoyed batting on it but is a bit disappointed with the way he got out. Adds that they are really excited to get the opportunity to play here and have posted a good total. Mentions that 300 plus on any wicket is a challenging total but will have to bowl tight lines. Mentions that after the first 20 or so overs, the ball was gripping a bit and the spinners will come into play in the second innings.

West Indies have kept themselves in the game thanks to some brilliant fielding and good bowling. They failed to keep things tight early on and India made the bulk of their runs in the first half of the innings. It needed a special effort from the skipper to open gates for them and slowly the Windies got their rhythm in the game. They kept on getting better as the game progressed. The pacers lacked consistency at the front but both the spinners in tandem did well to control the middle phase. West Indies have not been at their best with the bat in recent times and they will hope to give a tough fight here.

The top three notched big runs but the inexperienced middle order failed to build on the momentum. India at one stage were 230 for 3 thanks to the brilliance of Shikhar Dhawan, Shubman Gill and Shreyas Iyer. All of them scored more than fifty with Dhawan missing his ton by just three runs. But once the wickets fell, the middle order failed to capitalize on it. Yadav and Samson got a start but gave away their wicket. Hooda and Patel were struggling a bit and gave away their wicket at the wrong time. No doubt, 300 is an above-par total but the way India started the innings, it seemed they were eyeing for the 350-mark.

Excellent final phase by the Men in Maroon! At one stage, India were clearly eyeing a score of 350 but some tremendous bowling in the death saw them pulling India back. Still, it is a huge score and it will test the Windies' batting dearly.

FOUR! Romario Shepherd just misses his mark on the yorker and Shardul Thakur takes full advantage of it. Pitched up on middle, Thakur heaves it away between deep mid-wicket and long on to end the innings with a boundary. India finish with 308/7!
Full and outside off, Thakur drives it towards cover and denies the single. Mohammed Siraj scampers back in time as well.
WIDE! Pacy delivery, full and down the leg side, wide called.

Full and wide, angling across the right-hander. Mohammed Siraj reaches it and almost squeezes it past backward point but the substitute fielder over there, Keacy Carty makes a brilliant diving stop. Just a single then.
Full and on leg stump, Thakur heaves it towards wide long on and looks for two but has to settle for just a single.

Leg bye! Switches to around the wicket and bowls it full into the pads. Siraj fails to whip it away leg side and the ball goes off the pads towards backward point. The batters scamper through for a leg bye.
Full and straight, drilled down to long on for a single by Shardul Thakur. With that, the 300 is up for India.
Mohammed Siraj walks in.

OUT! TIMBER! Excellent comeback delivery from Alzarri Joseph! Full and on off stump, almost yorker length and above 140 clicks. Deepak Hooda goes a bit too hard at it as he looks to clobber it across the line. The ball tails in late and sneaks under the bat of Hooda to knock the off stump off the ground. Joseph finishes his spell with a double-strike and both set batters depart.
FOUR! Joseph attempts the yorker yet again but serves a high full toss on middle. Hooda heaves it away into the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
This is banged in short and around off, at 145 clicks. Shardul Thakur gets hurried on but manages to pull it in front of mid-wicket for a single.
Shardul Thakur comes in now.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Just too much heat on that one for Axar Patel to handle and Alzarri Joseph sends him packing. Keeps it full and bowls it on leg stump, at 142 clicks. Patel looks to flick it off his legs but ends up playing all over it and gets beaten for pace. The ball goes on to shatter the leg stump and Patel departs after a decent cameo. Joseph gets his first wicket of the match as well.
Very full, at the base of middle stump and with some serious heat behind it as well. Hooda jams it out towards long on and collects a run.
Nails the wide yorker, Patel squeezes it out towards backward point and picks up a single.

SIX! Deepak Hooda connects for the first time and makes it 20 runs off the over! Another slower delivery, bowled into the pitch and around off. Hooda is waiting for it and ends up crunching it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Full again, around off, Patel drills this one towards wide long off for yet another single.
Slower delivery, at just 103 clicks and targeting the hips. Hooda is way too early in his pull and gets it towards deep backward square leg for one.
Very full and wide, Patel gets low and slashes it with timing but straight to the man at deep cover for just a single.
FOUR! Seales goes searching for the wide yorker but serves a half volley and Axar Patel just nails it over extra cover for a boundary.
WIDE! Very full and wide, spilled beyond the tramline outside off.
SIX! Finally, Axar Patel breaks the shackles and connects one. Length ball, slanted across the left-hander, Patel is able to free his arms and thumps it back over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Goes full again and on off, Patel drills it down to long off for a run. With just three overs remaining, can India somehow get to 300?
Smart bowling! Angles across a length ball but it is the slower one. Patel looks to hang back and cut but fails to connect.

Excellent delivery! Nails the yorker on middle and leg stump at 140 KPH. Deepak Hooda manages to dig it out towards mid off for one more. The boundaries seemed to have completely dried up here for India.
Just one! Full and straight, at 146 clicks. Axar Patel wrists it nicely in front of square on the leg side but has to settle for the single.
On a hard length and around off, Deepak Hooda stays deep in his crease and looks to take it on. Hooda mistimes the big shot badly towards long on and picks up a single.
Full and straight, driven to the left of mid off for a quick single.
Length ball, around off, Patel opens his arms and muscles it towards long on for just another single.

No wide called! Slower one, bowled into the pitch and around leg stump. Axar Patel looks to pull but seems to have missed it. The umpire though deems that the ball came off the arms and doesn't signal a wide.
Good length, around off, this is played on the up towards sweeper cover for just a single.
Nicely bowled! Seales digs it in short and outside off but takes all the pace off the delivery. Deepak Hooda makes room and hops to slap it away but is undone by the lack of pace.
Just short of a length and around middle and leg. Axar Patel looks to flick off the back foot but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards backward square leg. Single taken.
Excellent length, angling into middle and leg. Hooda manages to drive it down to long on for a single.
Jayden Seales (7-1-30-0) is back into the attack.
Tries a yorker now but misses by a bit, it is hit to long on for a single.
Short ball, again well-directed. Patel pulls it to square leg for an easy single.
A slower length ball, outside off. Hooda guides it to third man for a single.
Fuller and on middle, flicked wide of deep square leg for a couple now.
This one is angled on the pads. Hooda is again to play it and mistimes his shot to point.
This one is on a length and outside off. Hooda is a bit late to punch it away and gets an inside edge onto the pads. Luckily for him, it didn't hit the stumps.
Good fielding! Short of a length and outside off. Patel punches it to point where the fielder dives to his left and stops it.
Hard length and on middle. Hooda forces it to long on for one.
Short again. This time Patel plays the pull shot to deep square leg for one.
Short and well-directed on the body. Patel fails to pull it and the ball rolls to cover.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to covers.
On middle, fuller and it is pushed towards to mid on for one.
Wide! Spills one full and down the leg side. Hooda misses his whip. A wide given.
A dot to end the over! Length and on off. Patel punches off the back foot but finds cover.
On a length and angling on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Touch fuller and shaping on middle. Hooda whacks it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, it is driven through covers for a single.
Axar Patel is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust! India losing their momentum here! On a length and around middle and off, this one nips back in off the surface and pings Samson on the pads who tries to flick it away. A massive appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Samson reviews it straightaway. Ultra Edge shows no bat. Ball Tracking shows umpire's call on wickets hitting and the original decision stays.
Outside off. Hooda punches it through covers for a single.
Romario Shepherd (4-0-27-0) is back on.
A maiden followed by just a single! Good bowling by Seales! Length and outside off, cut straight to point.
On a length and outside off. Samson tries to push off the back foot but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length and nipping back in off the surface. Samson taps it to the man at covers.
On middle, fuller, drilled down to long on for a run.
That was firmly struck! This is full and around off. Hooda comes down the track and smashes it straight back to Seales.
Short of a length and on off. Hooda drops it to covers.
Just two runs off the over. A brilliant spell from Hosein! Tossed up, outside off. Samson pushes again to covers. He has controlled the middle phase really well.
Fuller and outside off, drifting in. Samson defends to cover.
Flatter and on off, this one skids through. Samson punches it to covers.
Short again, outside off. Hooda steers it to short third man for a quick single.
Shorter and outside off. Hooda chops it on the off side.
Tossed up on off, pushed to long off for a single.
Time for the last Powerplay! Now, 5 fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the last over.
And again! Short and wide, Deepak Hooda slaps it straight to the man at point. Maiden!
Excellent fielding! On a good length and around off, Hooda looks to work it past point but the fielder over there makes a good stop down to his left.
Lovely bowling from Jayden Seales! Just a touch fuller and around the fourth stump line. This is angling in and zips past the outside edge of Hooda's willow.
Keeps it around the top of off stump and Deepak Hooda pushes it out firmly towards mid off.
Length, around off, Hooda looks to cover drive but mistimes it towards mid off.
Good length, over off stump. Hooda punches it towards mid on.
Gudakesh Motie has hurt himself in the process and the physio is out to assist him.

DROPPED! Akeal Hosein should have had a double-strike but Gudakesh Motie has grassed it. This is floated up well outside off, Deepak Hooda reaches out and drags the sweep shot hard and flat towards deep square leg. Motie comes in from the deep and he is a little late as he has to stretch forward. The ball goes in and out of his hands and Motie has hurt his thumb too. The batters pick up a single.
Around off, Hooda keeps it out on the off side.
Deepak Hooda walks out to the middle.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Akeal Hosein gets the big breakthrough and the dangerous Suryakumar Yadav departs early. On a nagging length yet again and around off, just turning away a bit and Yadav chooses to cut it off the back foot instead of getting onto the front foot and ends up getting a bottom edge. The ball goes back on to crash into the stumps and Hosein is elated. West Indies with yet another timely wicket and India just slowing down a touch here.
Flatter and on the pads, this is turned through square leg for a single.
SIX! Just a tad short and on off, Sanju Samson picks up the length early and absolutely muscles it over the cow corner fence for a maximum.
On a nagging length, around middle and leg. Samson defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! It was a quiet over up until then but Suryakumar Yadav makes sure he doesn't miss out. Short and on leg stump, Yadav pulls it away past square leg and finds the fence.
Good length, a bit slower in pace and outside off. Yadav stays on his toes and opens the face of the bat to play it towards point.
Goes fuller and around off, at 143 clicks. Yadav drives but straight towards mid on.
Length ball, angling in from well outside off. Suryakumar Yadav goes back and across to push it out towards cover.
Short of a length and around the hips, Samson half-pulls it down to deep backward square leg for one.
Starts off the new spell with a good-length ball on off. Sanju Samson stays inside the crease and taps it towards backward point.
Around off, this is just eased through the point region for a single.
Just holds it back a touch and bowls it on off, Samson goes on the back foot to push it back towards the bowler.
Quicker and flatter, around off. Suryakumar Yadav punches it out to deep cover and rotates the strike.
WIDE! Quicker delivery, trying to attack the pads but spills it down leg. Wide called.
On off, this is pushed back firmly towards the bowler.
On the shorter side and around off, Samson waits for it and taps it towards deep backward point for a run.
Slightly tossed up, on off, Samson defends it out with soft hands.
Drifted onto the pads, Sanju Samson eases it through mid-wicket for a single. Gudakesh Motie ends his spell with figures of, 10-0-54-2!
Sanju Samson is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Nicholas Pooran with a one-handed beauty and yet another set batter departs! Smart bowling from Gudakesh Motie, gives it some flight and serves it on off stump. Shreyas Iyer looks to go inside-out over extra cover but gets a bit undone in flight. Iyer doesn't get the elevation he would have liked but Pooran leaps up and sticks out a right hand to make the grab. West Indies might just have an opportunity now to slow down the scoring rate.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Gudakesh Motie

Commentary.Commentary: On off, this is pushed away onto the off side.
FOUR! This is full and on leg stump, Shreyas Iyer uses the bottom hand to flick it aerially and into the vacant cow corner fence.
Drops it a bit shorter and allows it to turn away from off stump. Iyer taps it towards point.
Floated up, full and on middle, this is driven down to long off for a single.
Shorter and on off, a bit quicker. Yadav cuts it to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Second of the over! Flighted, too full and on middle. Yadav gets on his knee and sweeps it through square leg for four.
Fifty for Shreyas Iyer! He paced his innings really well! He needs to end on a good note now! Darted on the pads. Iyer tucks it to the right of mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! This is full and on middle, tossed up. Iyer tries to go inside-out but the away turn edges it past short third man for a boundary.
Full again, on middle. Yadav eases it to long on for a single.
Fuller and on middle, pushed back to Hosein.
Drops it short and outside off. Yadav cuts it to deep point for a single.
On off, kept out.
Suryakumar Yadav walks in at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! Dhawan falls in the nervous 90s! It needed something spectacular to get rid of Dhawan and Brooks comes with an extra effort! Heartbreak for Dhawan! This is full and outside off, too much width and Shikhar Dhawan tries to chase this one. He tries to cut uppishly through backward point but Shamarh Brooks there dives to his right and plucks it out of the thin air. He does well to hold onto it after landing down hard.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Gudakesh Motie

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Clean as you like! Floats one full and around off. Dhawan slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a biggie. He is on 97.
Flatter and a bit of grip for Motie, this is cut to point for a single.
Too short and down the leg side, pulled to short fine leg for one.

Drinks! India seem to be well on course to achieving a score of around the 350-run mark and with just one batter back in the shed, one would expect them to get there with ease. Shikhar Dhawan is closing in on a century whereas Shreyas Iyer to a half-century and both batters will look to up the ante after that. West Indies need to break this partnership in order to bowl to the new batters and slow down the scoring rate otherwise they might be in for a very difficult chase later on. Also, Gudakesh Motie is back on for likely his final spell.
Play and a miss! Akeal Hosein has been decent so far! Slightly short and outside off. Iyer tries to cut but misses.
How has the missed the off stump! Flatter and on middle, it spins away off the deck. Iyer tries to defend but does so inside the line. The ball is inches away from hitting the off pole.
QUICK SINGLE! Floated and on middle. Dhawan turns it to mid-wicket and scampers across for a quick single. Pooran there has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
Tossed up on middle. Dhawan skips down and tucks it straight to square leg.
Angling on the pads. Iyer flicks it to square leg for one more.
Fuller and around off. Dhawan sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Flighted ball on middle. Dhawan works it to long on and will retain the strike.
There is an ascendency in Iyer's innings now! On off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Shorter and outside off, cut straight to point.
SIX! Makes the most of the free hit! This is full, floated and outside off. Iyer has ample time as he slogs it high over the cow corner fence.
No ball! On middle, played back to the bowler. A no ball is given as Pooran overstepped. Free hit coming up.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Tossed up on middle. Iyer comes down the track and tries to heave but his bat turns in his hands and it goes wide of long on into the deep mid-wicket fence.
Too short and on off. Dhawan cuts it to deep point for a single.
On middle. Dhawan dances down the track and wrists it to deep square leg for a single.
This is full and outside off. Iyer drives it to long off for a single.
Consistency from Hosein! Fuller and on midle. Dhawan turns it through square leg for a single.
Keeps it full and on off. Dhawan tries to flick it but hits straight to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, tucked to mid-wicket.
Drops it short and outside off. Iyer cuts it to deep point for a single.
On off, this is drilled down to long off for a single.
WIDE! This time Pooran spills it down the leg side, left alone for a wide.
On the pads again, this is played towards short fine leg.
Switches to over the wicket now and attacks the pads, Iyer tries to sweep it hard but fails to get it away.
SIX! On middle, Shreyas Iyer steps out and thumps it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Stays around the wicket to the right-hander and just tries to slide it across. Iyer flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
Starts off with a floater on middle. Dhawan pushes it down to long on and turns the strike over.
Nicholas Pooran to bowl now.
On middle and leg, Shikhar Dhawan punches it a bit uppishly and down to long on to pick up one more.
A hint of flighted, on middle, Dhawan nudges it towards square leg.
Slower through the air and fuller on off stump, the ball just turns a bit and Iyer caresses it towards cover for a run.
On the pads, Dhawan works it 'round the corner for one more.
On off stump, this is knocked down to long on for an easy single.
A bit of yes and no but they cross over with ease in the end. Around off, Dhawan presses forward and edges it down to short third man. The batters scamper through for a quick single.
This is quicker and fuller, fired into middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer does well to keep it out. Good comeback from Motie after being hit for a maximum off the first ball.
This is pushed through on off stump, Iyer keeps it out on the off side.
Flatter and around middle, Iyer pushes it towards mid on.
Around leg stump, this is tickled away down to fine leg for a single.
Switches to around the wicket now and fires it on the pads, Dhawan looks to use his feet but can't work it away.
SIX! Sweet sound off the bat and it goes all the way! Outside off, Shikhar Dhawan goes down on one knee and fetches the ball to slog-sweep it high and handsome over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Angled onto the pads, Dhawan turns it towards square leg and races across for a single.
Flatter and on off, Iyer knocks it down to long on for yet another single. Just milking the runs at the moment these two.
Around off, Dhawan uses his feet and drives it towards deep extra cover for one more.
On a length and around middle and leg, this is tucked away 'round the corner.
Quicker and flatter, at 92 KPH and on off. Iyer just cuts it to deep point and collects a single.
On the shorter side and on middle, Shikhar Dhawan hangs back and punches it well in front of mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
Flatter again and on middle, this is pushed away towards mid on.
Quicker and flatter, around off, Iyer keeps it out.
FOUR! This is dragged down on off stump, Shreyas Iyer powers it off the back foot and over extra cover to find the fence. Top shot!
This is fired in on leg stump, Shreyas Iyer looks to make room and go over extra cover but bunts it back to the bowler.
Moties sees Dhawan advancing and fires it in on the pads. Dhawan just works it towards square leg for one more.
This is drifted in full and on leg stump, Iyer makes room and pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
Spin from both ends now as Gudakesh Motie is brought back on.
Outside off on the shorter side. Iyer cuts it to deep point for a single. He wants another run but settles with a run.
Pitched up, around middle. Iyer gets a straight bat down to defend.
On middle, tucked past square leg for a run.
Flatter and outside off. Iyer opens the face of the bat and dabs it past short third man. Mayers runs back and saves a single. Three runs! 150 up for India.
Hosein keeps it tight as he bowls it fuller and on middle. Iyer defends on the front foot.
tossed up on middle. Dhawan plays it to deep square leg for one run.
Short in length and on middle. Iyer pulls it along the ground through mid-wicket for a brace.
On a length and tight on off. Iyer tries to drop and run but the fielder from point is quick to get to the ball.
Outside off, it is hit through point for a single.
IN THE AIR AND SAFE! Bangs a bouncer on middle. Iyer fails to connect it as he gets a top edge on his pull shot. The ball lobs in the air but well away from the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
FOUR! Well played! Short of a length and on middle. Iyer hangs back and pulls it through square leg, well wide of the fielder in the deep for four.
Length and outside off. Dhawan punches it through covers off the back foot for one.
Jayden Seales (4-0-20-0) is brought back on.
A single as Dhawan nudges it to deep mid-wicket. An eventful over comes to an end.
A huge appeal for LBW but not given! Slows it up and bowls it full and around leg. The ball grips a bit. Dhawan is late as he tries to flick it away but misses and gets hit on the pads.

NOT OUT! Tossed up, full and on off, spins a hint away. Iyer presses forward to defend but gets an outside edge to short third man. Dhawan is off for a single and Iyer is a bit late to respond. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but the replay shows Iyer stretched his bat in. A single.

Appeal for a run-out! The bowler, Akeal Hosein seems confident but the decision has been sent upstairs. The third umpire checks the replay and finds that Shreyas Iyer managed to drag his bat inside the crease just in time. NOT OUT!
Angles it full and on middle. Dhawan gets inside the line of the ball and plays it to square leg. One.
Flatter and on off. Dhawan stays back and forces it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off. Dhawan steps down and across to defend but inner edges it to square leg.
Akeal Hosein to have a bowl now.
Another short ball, this was inside the line of the stumps. Iyer ducks under it.
Short and around middle and leg. Iyer sits under it. He is not happy as he thinks it was a bit too short and wide.
Straight on the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for one.
Shorter and on the hips at 140 clicks. Kept out.
FOUR! Good shot! Length ball, outside off. Dhawan cuts it through point. The player from third man runs across and dives but to no avail.
On leg on a length. Dhawan bunts it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on top of off. Iyer could have pulled it but punches it back to the bowler. Just getting used to the pitch.
Again hits it nicely but finds the fielder! Full and on off, driven to covers.
Shorter and outside off. Iyer cuts it hard but finds point.
Darted on the pads. Dhawan rocks on the back foot and tucks it to deep square leg for one more.
Slides one on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off. Iyer pushes it to covers.
Excellent length, around the top of off. Dhawan plays it off the back foot but straight towards point.
Goes full and straight now at 144 clicks, Shreyas Iyer flicks it towards deep mid-wicket to get off the mark with a single.
Short again, on the bodyline. Iyer hops and keeps it down on the off side.
Good heat from Alzarri Joseph! This is a good bouncer, over middle and Shreyas Iyer just sways away from the line of the ball.
Uppish but in the gap! Back of a length, this is slanted well across off. Dhawan taps it past backward point and collects a single.
FOUR! Glorious from Shikhar Dhawan! Pitched up on off, Dhawan just stands tall and drives it on the up past mid off for a boundary.
A fourth dot in a row to end the over, just a single off it. Around off, this is pushed towards extra cover by Shreyas Iyer.
Full and fired into middle stump, Iyer does well to keep it out.
Around off, this is caressed towards cover.
On a fuller length and outside off, Iyer opens the face of the bat and guides it to backward point.
Flatter this time and on leg stump, Dhawan just turns it behind square on the leg side for a single.
This is pushed through quicker and on middle, Dhawan blocks it out.
Back of a length and around off, Dhawan steers it past backward point for a single.
Fuller in length and around off, this is driven straight towards mid off.
Shreyas Iyer is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! A bit too casual from Shubman Gill and he departs after a well-made fifty! On a shorter length from Alzarri Joseph and over middle. Gill hops and dabs it down to the right of mid-wicket. An easy single is on offer but Gill just jogs towards the bowler's end. Nicholas Pooran picks it up and in one fluid motion hits the bullseye at the bowler's end. Gill tries to hurry back but is a bit too late. The replay confirms the same and West Indies have the breakthrough they desperately needed. Gill will be disappointed with that but the hosts now have a chance to tighten the screws a bit.
A run out appeal! One single frame is enough to make the decision. OUT it is! Shubman Gill was way short of his crease.
The call is for two from Shubman Gill and they get it with ease. Length and on the pads, this is worked towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
FIFTY for the Indian skipper! Around the top of off, Shikhar Dhawan just opens the face of the bat a bit and drives it through extra cover for a run. A well-controlled innings so far from Dhawan.
Nicely driven but straight to the fielder. This is pitched up on off, Dhawan drives it towards the man at mid off.
Alzarri Joseph (3-0-25-0) is back on.
Slanting onto middle and leg, Shubman Gill gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it down to fine leg for a brace.
On a length and angling into middle, Gill turns it to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is knocked down to long on for a single.
Good stop from the skipper! Around middle, Shikhar Dhawan steps out and looks to work it through mid-wicket but can't get it through.
Excellent running! Nicely flighted, around off, Gill just plays it with soft hands towards cover for a quick single.
Floated up on middle, Dhawan nudges it towards square leg for a run.

Drinks! The best start India could possibly think of! Nicholas Pooran did opt to bowl first but there is nothing concerning for India till now. West Indies have lacked consistency and haven't created any chance as well to open the wickets column. If things go the same way, they will be chasing a huge score.
On a hard length and over off, Gill punches it out towards mid on.
Good length and around off, this is cut away to deep point for a run. It's just too easy for the Indian openers at the moment and West Indies need something to give here.
FOUR! Nicely played! Length again, angling in from well outside off, Dhawan waits for it and plays the square drive past point for a boundary.
Around the top of off, Gill punches it down to long on for another one.
On a good length and around the off pole, Dhawan tucks it away 'round the corner and rotates the strike.
Length ball on middle, this is flicked away to deep square leg for a single.
A shout for LBW but not given! This is full and around leg, slower as well. Dhawan looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
India are keeping the scoreboard ticking! Full and on middle. Gill pushes it to long on for one more.
Fullish and on off. Defended to covers.
Shorter delivery, outside off. Gill cuts it to deep point for two more.
Touch short and on off, punched to covers.
Pitched up, slanting on middle. Gill defends it out.
Another single as Gill drills this length ball to long on. Also, 100 up for India! They are going at a run rate above 7! Perfect start!
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
On a length and on middle. Gill forces it to mid-wicket. The fielder dives to his left but over the ball and gives away a single.
Slants it on the hips. Dhawan helps it to fine leg for one more.
Shepherd keeps it tight as Dhawan skips down. This is around off. Blocked out.
Length and outside off. Dhawan punches it to point.
Romario Shepherd (2-0-15-0) is back on.
Tossed it up on middle. Dhawan steps across and flicks it to deep square leg for one.
On middle, fuller and it is blocked out.
FOUR! 'Catch it,' is the shout but the ball travels well over and away from the fielder! Flighted, full and around off. Dhawan comes down the track and hits it over mid off for a boundary.
Slower through the air and on middle. Gill drills it to long on for one more.
A single now as Dhawan dabs it to deep backward point.
On middle, eased down to long on for one more.
Fifty for Shubman Gill! He is showing his class at every opportunity given! Length and on top of off. Gill nudges it through square leg for a single. His first fifty in this format.
On a length and outside off. It is played to cover.
On middle. Dhawan fends it to square leg and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Freebie! This is way too short and width given. Dhawan waits on the back foot and pulls it hard over mid-wicket for four.
Hits the deck hard and bowls it around off. Tapped to point.
Length and outside off. Gill cuts it square on the off side for a single.
Wide! Length and down the leg side. Gill leaves it alone. Wided.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Dhawan blocks it out.
Flatter and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it full and on middle. Blocked out.
SIX! Gill is not letting any bowler to settle in! This is in the slot, full and Gill uses his feet to heave it over long on for a biggie.
Fuller again, around off. Gill pushes it to the left of the bowler who parries it to the man at cover.
Too full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Time for Powerplay2! Now, four fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over. Also, Gudakesh Motie to bowl now.
A dot to end the first Powerplay, after which India are flying high at 73/0! Mayers comes from around the wicket to the left-hander and angles it into middle, Dhawan defends it off the front foot.
The keeper now comes up to the stumps in order to keep Gill from using his feet. Around the top of off, this is worked in front of square on the leg side for an easy single.
FOUR! Crunched! Gentle pace from Kyle Mayers, on the shorter side and outside off. Shubman Gill comes down the track and muscles it through wide mid on for a boundary.
Good length again, on off stump, Gill stays inside the crease and blocks it out.
On a good length and outside off, Gill leaves it alone.

FOUR! Pretty ordinary fielding from Shamarh Brooks. On a shorter length and well outside off, Gill reaches out and chops it towards point where Brooks lets it through and the ball goes away into the fence.
Kyle Mayers is now into the attack.

Good comeback from Romario Shepherd after conceding the early boundary. This is just a tad fuller and angled into middle and leg. Dhawan gets an inside edge onto the pads as the ball rolls towards the gully region.
Perfect length again and around off stump, Dhawan walks towards the ball and just blocks it back to the bowler.
Length again, angling into the off stump. Dhawan punches it out off the back foot towards cover-point.
Length this time, angling it onto the pads, Dhawan tucks it away to the man at short fine leg.
FOUR! Geez, that's some timing! Overpitched and around off, Shikhar Dhawan goes on the front foot and just caresses it through the cover-region for yet another boundary.
Shepherd comes from around the wicket and angles it into middle stump. Dhawan keeps it out on the off side.
Well-timed but straight to the fielder! Pitched up around off, Gill drives it firmly but the man at short extra cover makes a good stop. 10 off the over and India are off to a blistering start.
FOUR! This is just very inconsistent from the Windies pacers. Short and wide, Shubman Gill gets on top of the bounce and just taps it past the man at point to collect another boundary.
Goes back to a good length and bowls it on off stump. Gill gets behind the line to block it out.
FOUR! Just a bit too straight again and easily put away by Gill. This is angled onto the pads, Gill flicks it behind square on the leg side for yet another boundary.
Perfect length, around the top of off, Gill solidly defends it out on the off side.
Full and straight, Shubman Gill works it well in front of mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs.
Switches to around the wicket now and angles in a full ball from well outside off. Dhawan lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Just too easy to put away. This is on the pads, Dhawan just times it nicely through the vacant square leg region to pick up back-to-back boundaries. The 50 is also up for India.
FOUR! A real freebie from Romario Shepherd and Shikhar Dhawan gladly accepts the gift. This is overpitched and outside off, Dhawan creams it through extra cover for a boundary.
Right around the top of off, Dhawan stays back and just punches it out towards covers.
Hits the length hard and delivers it on middle. Dhawan mistimes the short-arm jab towards mid-wicket.

Starts off with a fuller delivery on the pads. Shubman Gill wrists it towards mid-wicket where the fielder gets a hand on it. The fielder then chases it down as the batters sprint back for the third, excellent running yet again.
Romario Shepherd is into the attack.
Keeps it full and on a tight line around the off pole. Shikhar Dhawan plays it towards point.
Goes a bit fuller and on off, Dhawan hangs back and just defends it out on the off side.
Good length this time, angling across off, Dhawan plays it with an angled bat and towards backward point.
Excellent running! Back of a length and over middle, Gill plays it with soft hands towards mid on and sets off for a quick single.
Tries to use his feet this time does Gill but Seales pulls the length back considerably. Gill adjusts and nudges it out towards covers.
On a length, angling onto middle. Gill presses forward and pushes it out towards mid on.

SIX! Poor delivery to end the over! Dhawan makes the most of it. This is down the leg side on the shorter side. Dhawan pulls it not off the middle but to the shorter side of the ground and it goes all the way over fine leg for six. Positive start for India.
Four dots now! Length and on top of off. Dhawan steers it to backward point.
Tight from Joseph! On a length and on middle. Dhawan drops it to covers.
This is around off. Dhawan dabs it to point.
Good piece of fielding! Fuller and outside off. Dhawan drives it but straight to the cover fielder.
Length and outside off, angling across. Left alone.
Two runs to end the over! On a length and on off. Gill steps down and bisects the mid-wicket and mid on fielder for a brace.
Three dots now! Length ball, around middle. Gill fends it to mid-wicket.
Angles it around middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
Not much movement there! The ball is coming nicely onto the bat! Good sign for India! On a length and on off, hit to covers.
On a length and on middle. Dhawan nudges it to mid-wicket for one more.
Fuller but this is way outside off. Dhawan is not tempted to play at it.
FOUR! That is a magnificent shot! On a length and just outside off. Gill punches off the back foot and finds the gap, through point for a boundary. 15 runs off the over.
EDGED AND SIX! Short of a length and on middle. Gill looks to pull but gets a top edge over fine leg for a biggie.
Four leg byes! On a length and angling on the hips. Gill shuffles across and tickles it to fine leg for a boundary. Given as leg byes as it came off the pads.
DROP AND RUN! This is full and on middle. Dhawan pushes it with soft hands to mid off and takes off for a quick single. Pooran has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Short in length and slanting just outside off. Dhawan shoulders arms to it.
Angles it across, thinking Dhawan will try to drive away from the body but Shikhar Dhawan is off to a watchful start. Leaves it alone.
Good comeback after going for six runs in the first couple of deliveries. Angles it on middle, it is tucked to mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off. Gill uses his feet and cuts it but again straight to the man at cover-point.
Seales drags his length back and makes it to nip away. Gill chops it to point.
Touch fuller and outside off. Gill reaches for it and drives it to the man at covers.
Again this is full and outside off, width on offer and Gill hits it through covers for a brace.
FOUR! Gill is off the mark in superb fashion! This is full and outside off, hint of away seam. Gill leans and drives it to the right of covers for a boundary.
Jayden Seales to operate with the other new ball.
Outside off, length and it is left alone.
FOUR! Just uses the pace! Really good shot! Short of a length and around off. Dhawan hangs back and ramps it to third man, no one standing there and it races into the fence.
FOUR! India and Shikhar Dhawan are underway! Pitched up, outside off. Dhawan drives it firmly through cover-point for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Dhawan leaves it alone.
Superb stop from King! Overpitched and outside off, it is there to be hit. Dhawan drives it to cover-point where King dives to his right and makes a solid stop.
Starts with a length ball, angling across, outside off. Dhawan leaves it alone for the keeper to collect.

We are done with the pre-match formalities and it's now time to play! The umpires and the players are out in the middle. The two openers for India, Shikhar Dhawan and Shubman Gill make their way out to the middle as the Windies team is seen in a huddle. Alzarri Joseph has the new ball in hand and is raring to go but just before the first ball is bowled, the players are seen taking the knee to show their support for the BLM movement. Let's play...

We are minutes away from the start of the match but first, the two sides line up for their respective national anthems. It will be the anthem of Trinidad and Tobago played first followed by the national anthems of India and West Indies.

Shikhar Dhawan, the captain of India, says that they were thinking about bowling first too as the wicket looks a bit sticky but is happy with batting first as well. Adds that he is a cool captain and makes sure that the team stays energetic and tries to keep the process going in order to get the wins. Mentions that the bench strength they have is complimentary and the exposure the young guys get is a good stage to showcase their talent. Adds that Suryakumar Yadav, Sanju Samson and Shreyas Iyer are a few guys to look out for and ends by saying that they get great support whenever they play here.

West Indies skipper, Nicholas Pooran says they will bowl first. Adds that they are doing it due to the weather around and they want to use the conditions early on. Shares that it was important to win the toss and hopes the player will be happy about it. Tells that they spoke about the recent loss and they want to improve in different areas. Informs Jason Holder is out due to Covid but Kyle Mayers is back after the injury and the rest are the same players from the Bangladesh series.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Shai Hope (WK), Brandon King, Shamarh Brooks, Kyle Mayers, Nicholas Pooran (C), Rovman Powell, Akeal Hosein, Romario Shepherd, Alzarri Joseph, Gudakesh Motie and Jayden Seales.

India (Playing XI) - Shikhar Dhawan (C), Shubman Gill, Shreyas Iyer, Suryakumar Yadav, Sanju Samson (WK), Deepak Hooda, Axar Patel, Shardul Thakur, Yuzvendra Chahal, Mohammed Siraj and Prasidh Krishna.
TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and they will have a BOWL first.

India have been on a roll in the limited overs format and having bagged both the T20I and ODI series against formidable hosts England, they will be looking to continue their march. As many as six senior players, including regular skipper Rohit Sharma, have been rested for this tour but given the depth in the Indian side, Shikhar Dhawan will look to guide them to yet another series win here. Who will start off on the right foot and take the lead in the series? We'll find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.
